text:
Built with the trees.

Two ropes for the X, 55 metres of spiral, four guys to four more trees, 363 metres of pigtails, one battery winch and, one day, a bigger one at the top. Forty triangles hung, joined and lifted without a scaffold, a crane or a foundation, by a network of living trees that were already doing the job. The ground can wait. Maybe it can wait for good.
